snippet.title: Eulogy for Nonno - Trailer
snippet.description:
It's always difficult to deliver flowers for a bereavement.
But it's even more difficult when the grieving family mistakes you for their long-lost cousin and won't let you leave "your" grandfather's wake.

Eulogy for Nonno is a free point and click adventure game, available for Windows, Linux and Mac
Get it here: https://gugames.itch.io/eulogy
